newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks close abbreviated session firmer.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks close abbreviated session firmer.

text.p: Toronto stocks finished firmer on Tuesday after an abbreviated and extremely quiet session with most players out of the picture ahead of the Christmas holidays.
"Everybody is shopping. They have to finish their shopping," Sonny Lennon, a trader at Deacon Capital Corp said.

The Toronto Stock Exchange shut at 1300 EST/1800 GMT along with New York, while Canadian bond trading is slated to stop at 1400 EST/1900 GMT. All North American financial markets will be closed on Christmas Day and Canadian exchanges will also be closed Boxing Day, December 26.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 4.92 points to 5867.82 in turnover of 39.79 million shares worth C$454 million. Advancing issues outpaced declines 439 to 383, with 328 holding their ground.
* Westcoast Energy said on Tuesday it declared a force majeure at its Pine River natural gas plant in northeast British Columbia after mechanical problems forced it to chop output by 33 percent.
The news emerged just before market close. The stock finished down 0.05 at 23.05.
* William Resources traded heavily after the mining company completed its takeover of Sweden's Terra Mining AB late last week.
* Precision Drilling shares were up 1.95 at 45.00 in heavy turnover.
